description: High-quality answer criteria for the Raise Getting Started interview.

primaryQuestions.question: What exactly are you asking for?
answerGuidance: Specific raise amount/range/percent
Other types of compensation
Approximate date you want change to take effect

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Clearly states a specific raise amount, range, or percentage and/or other types of compensation being requested.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides a specific approximate effective date for the compensation change.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Distinguishes between different components of compensation being requested.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts

primaryQuestions.question: Why do you believe this raise request is justified?
answerGuidance: Cite specific results delivered/impact to organization
Cite specific new/changed responsibilities that require a raise
Cite market data that shows current compensation is below market rate
Other examples: length of time since last raise

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Cites specific reason(s) why the compensation change is justified.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each reason, provides concrete details, evidence, and/or examples that substantiate the claim.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts, Examples, Evidence

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each reason, explains the positive impact on the employee's value to the organization.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts, Examples, Evidence

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each reason, explains the positive impact on the organization.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts, Examples, Evidence

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Cites a specific reason why the proposed effective date is justified.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Distinguishes between different types of justification, such as performance-based, market-based, and role-based.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts, Examples, Evidence

primaryQuestions.question: What makes this request feel fair in the context of your team or organization?
answerGuidance: Aligned with organization compensation policies: timing, pay bands, review protocols
Would not put undue stress on the budget of the organization
Would be perceived as equitable and consistent with peers
Fits within market rates for the role within the geographic area

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides one or more positions or arguments for why the raise request is fair.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides one or more positions or arguments for why the proposed effective date is fair.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts, Examples, Evidence

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each position or argument cited, provides supporting details, evidence, or examples.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts, Examples, Evidence

primaryQuestions.voluntaryCoverageRequirement: Not applicable; all criteria are mandatory.

primaryQuestions.question: Describe your work performance.
answerGuidance: What are the main goals for your role?
How have you performed against these goals?
Provide specific details supporting performance, such as achievements, metrics, new skills, and difficult situations
Areas working to improve

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Clearly lists and describes each goal the organization has assigned to the role.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each goal, defines the target expectation and timeframe.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each goal, states actual results achieved.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each goal, provides evidence supporting results, such as metrics, manager feedback, or customer quotes.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts, Examples, Evidence

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each goal, describes how the results support the raise request.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts, Examples, Evidence

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Clearly lists and describes one or more new skills acquired and how each impacted work performance.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts, Examples, Evidence

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Cites one or more difficult work situations and explains the impact on work and the organization.
highQualityCriteria.label: Objective Facts, Subjective Facts, Examples, Evidence

primaryQuestions.question: How would you describe your professionalism?
answerGuidance: Communication with co-workers, customers, and management
Reliability and commitment to team and outcomes
Attitude within the work environment
Respectfulness of others

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Highlights one or more interactions with co-workers that demonstrate professionalism and communication style.
highQualityCriteria.label: Subjective Facts, Examples

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Highlights one or more interactions in a team environment that demonstrate professionalism and communication style.
highQualityCriteria.label: Subjective Facts, Examples

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Highlights one or more interactions with management that demonstrate professionalism and communication style.
highQualityCriteria.label: Subjective Facts, Examples

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Highlights one or more interactions with outside stakeholders.
highQualityCriteria.label: Subjective Facts, Examples

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each interaction, details how the approach impacted the other parties and the organization.
highQualityCriteria.label: Subjective Facts, Examples, Evidence

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides an example where professionalism or communication improved performance, an outcome, or organizational objectives.
highQualityCriteria.label: Examples

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes professionalism and communication attributes that contribute to productivity and organizational success.
highQualityCriteria.label: Subjective Facts, Examples

primaryQuestions.question: What constraints do you realistically expect could affect this decision?
answerGuidance: Organization policy limitations or violations
Approval layers and timing limitations
Budget constraints
Peer equity perception
Limited visibility by management

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Lists one or more constraints that may impact the compensation decision.
highQualityCriteria.label: Details, Objective Facts

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each listed constraint, describes the constraint in detail.
highQualityCriteria.label: Details, Objective Facts, Examples, Evidence

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each constraint, connects the affected terms of the compensation request, such as amount, effective date, or type of compensation, and explains reasoning.
highQualityCriteria.label: Details, Objective Facts, Subjective Facts, Evidence

primaryQuestions.voluntaryCoverageRequirement: Not applicable; all criteria are mandatory.

primaryQuestions.question: If your manager cannot approve the raise exactly as requested, what tradeoffs or alternative outcomes would you consider?
answerGuidance: Must-have terms
Alternative means of compensation
Delaying the compensation change
Splitting the request over time
Performance triggers that unlock all or part of the raise

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Lists one or more alternative compensation outcomes they would consider.
highQualityCriteria.label: Raise

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each alternative outcome, provides details including description, execution details, quantitative values, and dates where applicable.
highQualityCriteria.label: Raise

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each alternative outcome, provides reasoning for why this would be acceptable.
highQualityCriteria.label: Raise

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each alternative outcome, connects it back to the original compensation request and explains why it is an acceptable alternative.
highQualityCriteria.label: Raise

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each alternative outcome, describes known constraints that might prevent the outcome.
highQualityCriteria.label: Raise

factTypes.name: Objective Fact
factTypes.definition: Verifiable, measurable data that remains consistent regardless of who observes it.
factTypes.example: Over the past 12 months, I increased personal sales by 20% year-over-year, generating an additional $500,000 in revenue.

factTypes.name: Subjective Fact
factTypes.definition: Personal perception, professional judgment, or interpretation of value, often focused on how work was done.
factTypes.example: I believe my ability to mentor new hires boosted team morale and streamlined onboarding.

terms.label: Compensation Amount
terms.description: Whether the requested raise amount, range, or percent is appropriate and well supported.

terms.label: Compensation Type
terms.description: Whether the requested mix of base pay, bonus, equity, paid time off, or other compensation is appropriate.

terms.label: Timing
terms.description: Whether the requested effective date, review timing, or implementation schedule is appropriate.

terms.label: Performance Justification
terms.description: Whether results, responsibilities, professionalism, and work performance justify the compensation request.

terms.label: Fairness & Market Fit
terms.description: Whether the request fits organization policy, peer equity, budget realities, and market compensation.

terms.label: Flexibility & Constraints
terms.description: Whether constraints, tradeoffs, and alternative outcomes are realistic and useful.

responseProfile.stance: The compensation request is not supported by the facts, timing, policy context, or business value.
The compensation request has limited support and leaves meaningful concerns unresolved.
The compensation request has some support but also has important gaps or tradeoffs.
The compensation request is well supported by performance, role scope, timing, and fairness considerations.
The compensation request is strongly supported by clear evidence, business value, market fit, and appropriate timing.
